mapper.insert: INSERT INTO articles (id, user_id, slug, title, description, body, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{article.id}, #{article.userId}, #{article.slug}, #{article.title}, #{article.description}, #{article.body}, #{article.createdAt}, #{article.updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT a.*, t.id as tag_id, t.name as tag_name FROM articles a LEFT JOIN article_tags at ON a.id = at.article_id LEFT JOIN tags t ON at.tag_id = t.id WHERE a.id = #{id}
SELECT a.*, t.id as tag_id, t.name as tag_name FROM articles a LEFT JOIN article_tags at ON a.id = at.article_id LEFT JOIN tags t ON at.tag_id = t.id WHERE a.slug = #{slug}
mapper.insert: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO tags (id, name) VALUES (#{tag.id}, #{tag.name})
